Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety review. The change affects contour toolpaths and can change posted G-code.

What looks good:

- The picked ring has equal tab spacing. Rings without a pick keep the old layout.
- Control compensation and an exit point with tabs are still refused by name.
- The decision record describes the scope of this slice of #1473.

Local results, after a clean trial merge with upstream main `e3f7d122b3c7fb86aff4c893667f02378fc707d8`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-motion --no-run` | Passed |
| motion library | 402 passed, 6 ignored |
| `contour_start` | 16 passed |
| `contour_inside_ramp` | 2 passed |
| `lead_room` | 4 passed, 1 ignored |
| `level_links` | 12 passed |
| `machining2d` | 66 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The quick gate dry run selected unrelated batch work because the trial merge was not committed. I used the source test maps to select the suites above. No GitHub runner was used. No golden files changed. No UI files changed, so screenshots are not required.

Requested before merge:

1. **P1 — `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour.rs:241`: keep leads out of standing tabs.** The new layout puts a tab immediately before the pick. The lead checks use the part boundary, which does not include this tab. The generator now accepts a picked start with tabs and a linear lead, then cuts through the tab. This can remove material that must hold the part. Make the lead and extension checks include the standing tabs, or refuse the unsafe combination by name. Add tests for both a linear lead-in and an independent linear lead-out.

I ran two fixture mutations of `a_picked_start_with_tabs_enters_every_level_at_its_projection`. I kept the PR source unchanged. Test copies and a small Cargo manifest were in `/tmp`; Cargo used the review worktree's target directory. I repeated the probes with the trial merge's Cargo.lock versions. The original test passed. Both mutations failed its existing assertion, `the tab before the pick stands`:

- **Linear lead-in:** set `p.lead = Lead::Linear { length: 5.0 }` and `p.links.approach.lead_out = Some(Lead::None)`. The floor feed runs from `(43, 25, -4)` to `(43, 20, -4)`.
- **Linear lead-out:** keep the perpendicular lead-in and set `p.links.approach.lead_out = Some(Lead::Linear { length: 5.0 })`. The floor feed runs from `(43, 24, -4)` to `(43, 19, -4)`.

Both moves cross the intended 4 mm tab at `x = 43`, `20 < y < 24`, below its top at `z = -3`. The test's probe point `(43, 22)` is cut at `z = -4` in both cases.

Note: `contour.rs` was already over 400 lines and grows by six lines in this PR. A later split can address this; it is not a blocker here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: P1 — keep leads and extensions out of standing tabs at a picked start.

Picked starts with tabs now refuse linear, arc, and tangential leads by name. They also refuse extensions. No leads and perpendicular leads remain available.

The `contour_start` tests pin both reported cases:
- `a_picked_start_with_tabs_refuses_a_linear_lead_in`
- `a_picked_start_with_tabs_refuses_an_independent_linear_lead_out`

Additional tests pin other lead shapes, both extensions, and tab preservation without leads. Removing the guard makes all four refusal tests fail. Restoring the guard makes all 18 contour-start tests pass.

The quick gate passed: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`. It reported 1,271 passed, 56 ignored, and no failures. Clippy passed for all `camcraft-motion` targets with warnings denied. Local checks used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=` because the sccache server was unavailable.

New head: `9cfc4530f88ba9f14ded3029c5937a994e5d8a6d`.

Please review this head again. The PR remains a draft.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety review. The change affects contour toolpaths and can change posted G-code.

What looks good:

- The new guard addresses the previous P1 finding. It refuses unsafe lead shapes and extensions by name.
- Separate tests cover the reported linear lead-in and independent linear lead-out cases.
- No leads and perpendicular leads remain available. Rings without a pick keep the automatic tab layout.
- The decision record explains the conservative refusal and the scope of this slice of #1473.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream main `4e0b9abefcb225595d47d9c69a2482d6359b190f`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-motion --no-run` | Passed |
| motion library | 402 passed, 6 ignored |
| `contour_start` | 21 passed |
| `contour_inside_ramp` | 2 passed |
| `lead_room` | 4 passed, 1 ignored |
| `level_links` | 12 passed |
| `machining2d` | 66 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The checks used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=` and ran in the foreground. The selected suites follow the source test maps. No GitHub runner was used.

I independently ran two guard mutations in source copies under `/tmp`. The copies used the trial merge's dependency versions. The review worktree source stayed unchanged.

| Mutation | Guard disabled | Guard restored |
|---|---|---|
| Disable only the lead-in shape check; run `a_picked_start_with_tabs_refuses_a_linear_lead_in` | Failed: `expected a refusal` | Passed |
| Disable only the lead-out shape check; run `a_picked_start_with_tabs_refuses_an_independent_linear_lead_out` | Failed: `expected a refusal` | Passed |

The current guard refuses both previously reported unsafe inputs. The suite also checks arc and tangential leads, both extensions, and tab preservation without leads.

Requested before merge: none. The previous P1 finding is addressed on this new head.

No golden files changed. No UI files changed, so screenshots are not required. I checked the rules against upstream main's current `AGENTS.md`.

Note: `contour.rs` already exceeds 400 lines and grows in this PR. A later split can address this; it is not a blocker here.

The PR author is NeoTech. The draft state stays unchanged for the author to set.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Merged by the order of the maintainer of 2026-11-16. No second safety-floor review was made.
